design.target_selection: Metadata-only public index seeded deterministic ordering; excludes all prior 13 target names, up to four new complete four-scan cadences.
design.control: Identical anchor scan on both OFF measurements, reverse OFF/ON/OFF comparison; empirical control alert incidence, not true astrophysical false-alarm probability.

limitations: Actual targets and results unverified pending run.
Top-five cap and per-drift peak cap; counts censored.
Relative raw-power injection sensitivity only; no absolute flux or beam calibration.
Real OFF not known null, repeated tiles correlated. No new independent telescope observations.
